info.title: R.O.C.K.Y. API
info.description: REST API of R.O.C.K.Y. Authentication uses httpOnly cookies set by /auth/signup and /auth/login (ADR-003). Errors use the standard error body (design §5.1).

rocky_id.name: rocky_id
rocky_id.description: Firebase ID token, sent to every endpoint.

rocky_refresh.name: rocky_refresh
rocky_refresh.description: Firebase refresh token, sent only to /api/v1/auth/* (refresh, logout).

password.description: At least one letter and one number.

username.description: Trimmed and lowercased before validation. Reserved names that collide with routes (e.g. me, search, admin, api, settings) are rejected.

error.description: Standard reason phrase of the status.

example: email must be a valid email address
message.description: Safe client message. Validation errors return one message per failed rule.

url.description: Long-lived Firebase download URL, for displaying the media.

path.description: Storage path, sent back when creating the post (ADR-007).

contentType.description: Detected from the file contents, not from the name or declared type.

mediaPath.description: The `path` returned by POST /uploads with purpose `post`.

likedByMe.description: Whether the signed-in user has liked the post.

savedByMe.description: Whether the signed-in user has saved the post.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

caption.description: The new caption; an empty string removes it.

likedByMe.description: Whether the signed-in user now likes the post.

likeCount.description: The post's like count after the change.

savedByMe.description: Whether the signed-in user now has the post saved.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

actor.description: The user who liked, commented or followed.

post.description: Set for LIKE and COMMENT, null for FOLLOW.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

isFollowing.description: Whether the signed-in user follows this user.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

bio.description: Trimmed. An empty string or null clears the bio.

avatarPath.description: The `path` returned by POST /uploads with purpose `avatar`, or null to remove the avatar.

notificationsEnabled.description: FR-SET-02: whether new notifications are created.

isFollowing.description: Whether the signed-in user follows this user.

isMe.description: Whether this is the signed-in user's own profile.

isFollowing.description: Whether the signed-in user now follows the user.

followerCount.description: The user's follower count after the change.

count.description: Conversations with at least one unread message from the other participant. Several unread messages in one conversation count once.

lastMessage.description: The latest message, or null if none has been sent yet.

unreadCount.description: Messages from the other participant that you have not read.

lastMessageAt.description: Time of the latest message, or of creation if there is none. Sort key.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

recipientId.description: ID of the user to message.

senderId.description: Compare with your own ID to align the bubble.

readAt.description: When the recipient read it; null while unread.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.
